landing.faq2A: Every account starts with phone number verification through a one-time code. After that, our team manually reviews each profile before it becomes visible to others.

landing.regionsTitle: Matrimony profiles from countries around the world
landing.regionsBody: Marriage is a family decision, and most families would rather their son or daughter settle within a reasonable distance of home — or somewhere the family already has roots. That is why the directory is organised by country first: you can open the country you actually care about, then narrow further by state, city, education, profession, religion and marital status. Every country below has verified brides and grooms currently searching.
landing.regionsCommunityBody: Faith and community are the first filter most families apply. Start from yours and refine from there.
landing.aboutTitle: A matrimony platform built for families, not borrowed from a dating app
landing.aboutLead: Biye Kora Lagbe was built around the way marriages are actually arranged. A search usually starts with one person, but the decision is made together — parents, an elder brother, an aunt who knows everyone. Most matrimonial sites ignore that entirely and hand you a dating app. We designed for the family from the first screen: profiles that read like a proper biodata, photos that stay private until you say otherwise, and conversations your guardians can be part of without anyone feeling watched.
landing.aboutVerificationTitle: Every profile is verified before anyone can see it
landing.aboutVerificationBody: Registration begins with a phone number and a one-time code, so no account exists without a working number behind it. From there our moderation team reviews the profile by hand — photographs, stated age, education, profession and marital status — before it becomes visible in the directory. Anything inconsistent is sent back for correction, and profiles that misrepresent basic facts are removed. It makes joining slower than a site that publishes instantly, and that is the point: the profiles you browse have all cleared the same check yours did.
landing.aboutPrivacyTitle: You decide who sees your photographs and your contact details
landing.aboutPrivacyBody: Your pictures are blurred to everyone by default, and the blurring is done on our servers — not with a CSS filter that anyone could remove from their browser. Your phone number is never printed on your profile. When someone sends an interest you see their profile first and decide whether to open yours in return, so nothing about you travels further than you allow. You can hide your profile from the directory at any time, and deleting your account removes your data rather than merely disabling the login.
landing.aboutFamilyTitle: Built so your family can take part properly
landing.aboutFamilyBody: A profile can be created and managed by a parent, a brother or a sister rather than by the candidate — that is how a large share of proposals genuinely begin. Every profile can be exported as a printable PDF biodata, the document families actually forward to relatives and discuss at home. And conversations are structured to move from an interest, to a message, to a call between both families, in that order, instead of pushing two strangers straight into private chat.
landing.aboutPricingTitle: Free to join, with clear pricing in taka
landing.aboutPricingBody: Creating a profile, appearing in the directory, browsing matches and receiving interests all cost nothing. You pay only for optional extras — seeing exactly who has liked you, or featuring your profile at the top of a search — from a wallet you top up with bKash or Nagad, or through our support team if you are paying from outside Bangladesh. There is no subscription, no card stored on file, and no plan that renews on you quietly.

featuresPage.f1Body: Every account starts with a 6-digit code sent to a real phone number — no email-only sign-ups, no bots.
featuresPage.f2Body: Our team checks every new profile — photos, details, and intent — before it ever goes live.
featuresPage.f3Title: A verified badge you can trust

featuresPage.section2Body: Searching for marriage is personal. Biye Kora Lagbe gives you fine-grained control instead of exposing everything to everyone.
featuresPage.f4Body: Your contact details stay hidden until you choose to connect with someone. Nothing leaves your profile without your say-so.

howItWorksPage.heroTitle: How Biye Kora Lagbe works, from sign-up to proposal
howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: Five clear steps from creating a profile to a proposal your families can act on — so you and your parents always know what happens next, and what it costs.
howItWorksPage.leadIn: There are no confusing tiers, no hidden fees and no unverified strangers on this platform. Below is the whole process, in order: what you fill in, what our team checks, how you find people, how a conversation actually opens, and where your family comes in. It usually takes about five minutes of your time and 24 hours of ours.
howItWorksPage.step1Body: Sign up with your mobile number and confirm it with the six-digit code we send you. Then build the biodata: name and date of birth, country, state and city, religion, education, profession and working sector, marital status, family background, and what you are looking for in a partner. Add at least one clear photograph of your face — it stays blurred to everyone until you decide otherwise.
howItWorksPage.step1Tip: Profiles with a clear photograph and a fully completed biodata appear in far more filtered searches, because most members search on those exact fields.
howItWorksPage.step2Body: Nothing is published automatically. Our moderation team reads every submission by hand and checks that the photographs, stated age, education, profession and marital status hang together. If something needs correcting we tell you what and why, rather than leaving you waiting. Only once it passes does your profile enter the directory — which is why every profile you see later has cleared the same check.
howItWorksPage.step2Tip: Most profiles are reviewed within 24 hours, and you are notified the moment yours is live.
howItWorksPage.step3Body: Start with your own country and city, then narrow by age, height, religion, education, profession, working sector and marital status. Distance is shown on each match so you can judge what is realistic for both families. You can save a search as a link and send it to a parent or sibling who is helping you shortlist.
howItWorksPage.step3Tip: You can search any country from wherever you are, and register with an address outside your home country.
howItWorksPage.step4Body: You send an interest first. If it is accepted, a conversation opens inside the platform — your phone number is never revealed by it. Photographs stay blurred until you each choose to open your profile to the other. Everything up to this point is free; you only spend from your wallet if you want to see exactly who has already liked you.
howItWorksPage.step4Tip: Nothing about your contact details leaves the platform until you decide to share it.
howItWorksPage.step5Title: Involve your family, at your pace
howItWorksPage.step5Body: Bring your family in whenever you are ready. Download the profile as a printable one-page biodata PDF — the document relatives actually forward and discuss at home — and let both sides review the particulars before anyone meets. From there the conversation moves to a call between the families and, if it goes well, to a meeting.
howItWorksPage.step5Tip: You decide what is shared and when. Nothing is sent to anyone on your behalf.
howItWorksPage.q1Q: How long does profile review take?
howItWorksPage.q1A: Most profiles are reviewed within 24 hours. You'll be notified as soon as yours is approved and visible to others.
howItWorksPage.q2Q: What happens if my profile is rejected?
howItWorksPage.q2A: You'll see the reason directly in Settings, and can update your details and resubmit for review.
howItWorksPage.q3Q: Can I edit my profile after it's approved?
howItWorksPage.q3A: Yes — any changes you save go through a quick re-review before they're visible to others again, so profile details always stay accurate.
howItWorksPage.ctaBody: Setting up your profile takes about five minutes, and our team usually finishes the review within 24 hours. It costs nothing to find out who is looking.
howItWorksPage.q4Q: What does it cost to go through this whole process?
howItWorksPage.q4A: Nothing, for every step described above. Registering, being verified, appearing in the directory, browsing and filtering, sending interests, accepting them and messaging a match are all free. The only paid features are seeing who has liked you before you decide, and featuring your profile at the top of search results — both paid from a wallet you top up in taka through bKash or Nagad.
howItWorksPage.q5Q: Can my family take part without me handing over my account?
howItWorksPage.q5A: Yes. A profile can be formally created and managed by a parent or sibling, and it is marked as such. If you manage it yourself, the biodata PDF is designed to be shared and discussed at home without anyone needing your login.

assistantService.heroSubtitle: A dedicated match advisor who searches, verifies and introduces on your behalf — for families who would rather not do it alone.
assistantService.formSubtitle: Add your contact info and our team will reach out
assistantService.formSuccess: Thanks! Our team will contact you shortly.
assistantService.formError: Could not submit your request. Please try again.
assistantService.step1Body: You are assigned one advisor who stays with you for the whole plan. They begin with a long conversation — not a form — about age, country, religion and level of practice, education, profession, family background, and the things that are genuinely non-negotiable versus merely preferred.
assistantService.step2Body: Your advisor writes or rewrites your profile and selects your photographs, following what actually works on the platform. If you prefer, your profile can be kept out of public search entirely and shown only to the candidates your advisor hand-picks.
assistantService.step3Body: Every week your advisor sends you a shortlist drawn from the verified directory, with the reasoning for each name. They confirm the particulars with the other side before a profile reaches you, so you are not the one discovering that a stated profession or marital status was wrong.
assistantService.step4Body: When both sides are interested, your advisor arranges the first call or meeting at a time and place that suits both families, and stays involved through the introduction rather than handing you a phone number and stepping away.
assistantService.formPlanHint: Optional — your advisor will go over the plans with you on the first call.
assistantService.faq1Q: What is the benefit of the assistant service?
assistantService.faq1A: A dedicated advisor is assigned to you. They first learn your detailed requirements, then search for suitable profiles and send them to you weekly. Based on your choice, your advisor communicates with the other party and, on mutual agreement, arranges a meeting. They also manage your profile and photos for you.
assistantService.faq2Q: How will I interact with my advisor?
assistantService.faq2A: Your advisor reaches out by phone and keeps you updated with matches on a weekly basis, or as you prefer.
assistantService.faq3Q: How does assistant service differ from other packages?
assistantService.faq3A: Regular packages are self-service — you browse and manage everything yourself. With the assistant service, a dedicated advisor handles your profile, matches, and meeting arrangements for you.
assistantService.faq4Q: How many calls or meetings will be arranged during my membership?
assistantService.faq4A: This depends on your plan and mutual interest with matches — your advisor will keep you informed throughout your membership period.
assistantService.faq5Q: Can I hide my profile from public search?
assistantService.faq5A: Yes — ask your advisor to set your profile to private, and it will only be shared with the matches they hand-pick for you.
assistantService.faq6Q: How can I buy the assistant service package?
assistantService.faq6A: Submit your contact info above and our team will reach out to guide you through the plans and payment.
assistantService.intro: Most people who come to us for the assisted service are in one of three situations: a parent managing a search for a son or daughter who has no time for it, a member living abroad who cannot fly home to meet families, or someone who has been searching for months and wants a shorter list of genuinely serious candidates instead of a longer one. In each case the work is the same — understanding what you actually need, finding the small number of people who fit it, confirming that the particulars are true, and handling the first approach so nobody has to make an awkward call cold.
assistantService.whoBody: It suits parents and elder siblings running a search on someone else’s behalf, members living abroad who want someone who shares their background, second marriages and other searches that need to be handled discreetly, and anyone whose own attempts have produced plenty of matches but no serious proposals. It is not the right service if you enjoy browsing and want to search yourself — the free platform already does that well.
assistantService.includedTitle: What is included in every plan
assistantService.includedBody: One dedicated advisor for the full period; a professionally written profile and photograph selection; optional privacy so your profile never appears in public search; a hand-picked shortlist each week with the particulars already confirmed; the first approach to the other family made on your behalf; and coordination of calls and meetings for as long as your plan runs.
assistantService.pricingBody: One payment for the full period, in taka, with no renewal. Which plan makes sense usually depends on how specific your requirements are — a narrow brief needs longer, because there are fewer people to find.
assistantService.faq7Q: Is the assisted service refundable if no match is found?
assistantService.faq7A: The fee pays for your advisor’s time over the plan period, not for a guaranteed marriage, so it is not refundable once the work has begun. We would rather tell you honestly before you pay whether your requirements are realistic for the plan you are considering, which is why every enquiry starts with a conversation.
assistantService.faq8Q: Will my family be involved in the process?
assistantService.faq8A: As much as you want. Many of our clients are parents, and in those cases the advisor works with the family directly throughout. Where a candidate is managing their own search, the advisor can still speak to their parents before a meeting is arranged.

faqPage.heroSubtitle: Everything worth knowing before you join, and everything members ask us after. If your question is not answered here, our team will answer it directly.
faqPage.leadIn: From creating a profile to getting verified, protecting your photographs and paying safely in taka — grouped by topic so you can find your answer without reading the whole page.
faqPage.cat1q1Q: Is Biye Kora Lagbe free to join?
faqPage.cat1q1A: Yes. Creating a profile, verifying your phone number, appearing in the directory, browsing matches, sending interests and receiving them are all free, with no time limit and no trial that quietly expires. You only need a wallet balance for two optional things: seeing exactly who has liked you, and featuring your profile at the top of search results.
faqPage.cat1q2Q: What do I need to create a profile?
faqPage.cat1q2A: A working mobile number is enough to begin. After the one-time code you add your name, date of birth, country, state and city, religion, education, profession and marital status, then upload at least one clear photograph of your face. The more of the biodata you complete, the more often your profile appears in other members’ filtered searches.
faqPage.cat1q3Q: How long does sign-up take, and when does my profile go live?
faqPage.cat1q3A: The form itself takes about five minutes. Your profile then goes to our moderation team, and review is usually finished within 24 hours. You will be told if something needs correcting rather than left waiting — and until the review passes, your profile is not visible to anyone else.
faqPage.cat1q4Q: Can a parent or sibling create the profile instead?
faqPage.cat1q4A: Yes, and a large share of profiles are created this way. When you register you can state that the profile is being managed by a parent, brother, sister or other relative. It is shown on the profile, so anyone considering a proposal knows from the start who they will be speaking to first.
faqPage.cat2q1A: In two stages. Every account begins with phone verification through a one-time code, so no profile exists without a real number behind it. Our team then reviews the profile by hand — photographs, stated age, education, profession and marital status — before it becomes visible in the directory. Profiles that misrepresent basic facts are removed rather than merely hidden.
faqPage.cat2q2Q: What does the verified badge mean?
faqPage.cat2q2A: It means that profile has cleared both stages: a confirmed phone number and a manual review by our moderation team. It is not a paid badge and it cannot be bought — every profile in the directory has passed the same check.
faqPage.cat2q3Q: Can a profile lose its verified status?
faqPage.cat2q3A: Yes. Editing key details sends the profile back through review, and the changes stay invisible to other members until it passes again. A profile can also lose its badge after upheld reports, or if the details on it stop matching what was originally verified.
faqPage.cat2q4Q: What is selfie verification and do I have to do it?
faqPage.cat2q4A: It is an optional extra step: you submit a live selfie that our team compares against the photographs on your profile. It is the strongest signal available that the person in the pictures is the person writing to you, and profiles that complete it are noticeably more likely to receive a reply.
faqPage.cat3q1A: Nobody, until you decide. Your pictures are blurred by default and the blurring is applied on our servers, so it cannot be undone by inspecting the page or the network response in a browser. You choose whose view you open, one person at a time.
faqPage.cat3q2Q: Is my phone number ever shown on my profile?
faqPage.cat3q2A: No. Your number is used to verify your account and nothing else — it is never printed on your profile, never included in the biodata PDF, and never sold or passed to a third party. Contact details are exchanged between two members only when both sides have chosen to share them.
faqPage.cat3q3Q: Can I block or report someone?
faqPage.cat3q3A: Yes, in one tap from their profile or from your conversation. Blocking is immediate and mutual: they can no longer see your profile or contact you. Every report is read by our moderation team, and accounts that break the rules are suspended or removed.
faqPage.cat3q4Q: Can I hide my profile or delete my account?
faqPage.cat3q4A: Both. You can hide your profile from the directory at any time and keep your account, which is what most members do once a proposal is progressing. Deleting the account removes your profile, photographs and messages rather than just disabling the login.
faqPage.cat4q1A: Members register from countries across the world, and the directory narrows all the way down to state and city. Whether you are searching close to home or for someone from your community living abroad, the same filters apply.
faqPage.cat4q2Q: How do interests and messaging work?
faqPage.cat4q2A: You send an interest first. If it is accepted, a conversation opens between you, and either side can bring their family into it before anything moves off the platform. The order is deliberate: an interest, then a conversation, then the families — rather than dropping two strangers straight into a private chat.
faqPage.cat4q3Q: Can I filter by religion, education or profession?
faqPage.cat4q3A: Yes. The directory filters on age, height, country, state, city, religion, education, profession, working sector and marital status, and the filters combine, so you can be as specific as your family actually is. Searches can be shared as a link, which is useful when a relative is doing the shortlisting.
faqPage.cat4q4A: A printable one-page summary of a profile, laid out the way families already expect to receive a proposal. It is the document relatives forward to each other and discuss at home, and it can be downloaded from any profile you have access to.
faqPage.cat5q1Q: How do I top up my wallet?
faqPage.cat5q1A: Open Wallet from your account menu, choose an amount and pay with bKash or Nagad. Nagad top-ups are confirmed automatically. For bKash you send the amount to the merchant number shown on screen and submit the transaction ID, which our team then approves — usually the same day. Paying from outside Bangladesh? Message support and we will arrange it manually.
faqPage.cat5q2Q: What exactly am I paying for?
faqPage.cat5q2A: Only two things: seeing the full profile of someone who has already liked you, and featuring your profile at the top of search results for a set period. Creating a profile, browsing, filtering, sending interests and messaging a match are always free.
faqPage.cat5q3Q: Is paying through bKash and Nagad secure?
faqPage.cat5q3A: Yes. Payments run through bKash’s and Nagad’s own checkout, so your PIN and account details never reach our servers. We store only the amount, the transaction reference and the resulting wallet balance.
faqPage.cat5q4Q: Are there subscriptions or automatic renewals?
faqPage.cat5q4A: No. There is no subscription, no card kept on file and nothing that renews on its own. You top up a balance in taka when you want to, spend it on what you choose, and unused balance simply stays in your wallet.
faqPage.cat6q1A: A paid service for families who would rather not search alone. You are assigned a dedicated advisor who takes your criteria in detail, shortlists candidates from the verified directory, confirms the particulars with each side, and arranges the first introduction between both families.
faqPage.cat6q2Q: How is it different from using the site myself?
faqPage.cat6q2A: The searching, the shortlisting and the first awkward conversations are done for you. It suits parents who are managing a search on behalf of a son or daughter, members living abroad who cannot travel to meet families, and anyone who wants a smaller number of serious candidates rather than a long list.
faqPage.cat6q3Q: How do I start with an advisor?
faqPage.cat6q3A: Read the plans on the assistance service page and contact us by phone, WhatsApp or the contact form. We will go through your requirements before you pay anything, so both sides know whether the service is the right fit.
faqPage.ctaBody: Create a free profile and see the platform for yourself, or contact our team and we will answer directly — by phone, WhatsApp or email.

registerInfo.title: What registering involves
registerInfo.body: Creating a profile on Biye Kora Lagbe is free and takes about five minutes. There is no trial that expires, no card to enter, and no charge for appearing in the directory, browsing matches, sending an interest or replying to one.
registerInfo.needBody: A working mobile number for the one-time code, your date of birth, your country, state and city, your religion, your highest qualification and your profession, and at least one clear photograph of your face. If you are creating the profile for a son, daughter, brother or sister, you can say so during registration and it will be shown on the profile.
registerInfo.reviewBody: Nothing is published automatically. Our moderation team reads every new profile and checks that the photographs and the stated age, education, profession and marital status hang together. Most reviews finish within 24 hours, and you are notified the moment yours is live. If something needs correcting we tell you what and why rather than leaving you waiting.
registerInfo.privacyBody: Your photographs are blurred to everyone by default, and the blurring is applied on our servers rather than in the browser. Your mobile number is never printed on your profile and never appears in the biodata PDF. You choose whose view you open, one person at a time, and you can hide your profile from the directory or delete your account at any point.

profiles.title: Verified Bride & Groom Profiles Worldwide
profiles.subtitle: Browse verified members from countries around the world. Every profile here has passed phone verification and a manual review by our team before being listed.
profiles.seoIntro: Use the filters to narrow the directory by age, height, country, state, city, religion, education, profession, working sector and marital status — the criteria families actually weigh up. Photographs stay blurred until a member chooses to open their profile to you, and contact details are never shown publicly. Sending an interest is free; you only pay to see who has already liked you.
profiles.hubIntro: Most searches begin from one of a handful of criteria — whether you are looking for a bride or a groom, which country you want to search, and the religion, education, profession and marital status your family has in mind. Each link below opens the directory with that filter already applied; from there you can narrow further, and you can combine as many filters as you like.
profiles.hubGenderBody: Start with who you are looking for. Every member below has completed phone verification and a manual review, and no profile appears in either list until it has passed both.
profiles.hubDivisionBody: Marriage is a family decision, and most families would rather settle their son or daughter within reach of home — or somewhere the family already has roots. Open the country you actually care about, then narrow by state and city from inside the filters. Members register from countries across the world; these are simply the most searched.
profiles.hubReligionBody: Faith and community are the first filter most families apply. Start from yours and refine from there.
profiles.hubEducationBody: Filter by highest qualification, from SSC through to a doctorate. Members can also enter their institution and field of study, both of which are searchable inside the directory.
profiles.hubProfessionBody: The professional area a member works in, from medicine and engineering to government service and business. Working sector — private, government, defence or self-employed — is a separate filter you can combine with this one.
profiles.hubStatusBody: Second marriages are searched for as seriously as first ones here, and profiles state their status plainly rather than leaving it to be discovered later.
profiles.hubTrustTitle: What every profile in this directory has already passed
profiles.hubTrustBody: No profile is listed automatically. Registration begins with a mobile number and a one-time code, so no account exists without a working number behind it. Our moderation team then reviews the profile by hand — photographs, stated age, education, profession and marital status — and anything inconsistent is sent back for correction before the profile becomes visible. Editing a live profile sends it back through the same review, so what you read here stays accurate rather than being true only on the day it was written.
profiles.hubLinkHowItWorks: See how the whole process works

contactPage.heroTitle: Contact the Biye Kora Lagbe team
contactPage.heroBody: Our office is in Sirajganj and our team answers in Bangla and English. Call or message us about anything you are unsure of — how verification works, why a profile is still under review, a wallet top-up that has not appeared, a member you want to report, or whether the assisted matchmaking service is right for your family. Parents and guardians are very welcome to call on a candidate's behalf.
contactPage.heroHoursBody: Phone and WhatsApp are answered during business hours, seven days a week. Messages sent through the form below are answered by email, usually within one working day. Profile reviews are handled separately and are normally finished within 24 hours of submission — you do not need to contact us to chase one.

legal.intro: Please read these terms carefully. By creating an account or using Biye Kora Lagbe you agree to everything set out below.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and the control you have over it.
legal.termsS1Title: 1. Who may use Biye Kora Lagbe
legal.termsS1Body: You must be at least 18 years old and legally free to marry under the laws of the country you live in. One person may hold one account only. A profile may be created and managed on a candidate’s behalf by a parent, sibling or relative, provided the candidate has consented to it and the information given is accurate.
legal.termsS2Title: 2. Your profile and the accuracy of your information
legal.termsS2Body: Everything you enter — your name, age, education, profession, income, family details and photographs — must be true and must describe you or the candidate whose profile you manage. Every profile is reviewed before it becomes visible, and we may reject or remove one that appears false, misleading or impersonating someone else. Your profile returns to review whenever you edit it.
legal.termsS3Body: Verification is optional but encouraged. If you submit a National ID number and a selfie, we use them solely to confirm you are who you say you are, and we display only a verification badge to other members — never the documents themselves.
legal.termsS4Body: Contact details are protected by an unlock fee charged from your wallet. Unlocking a profile reveals that member's name, phone number, email address and full address, and lets you message them. Wallet top-ups are processed by bKash and Nagad; the current unlock price and any package prices are shown before you pay.
legal.termsS5Body: An unlock is delivered the moment it is charged, so unlock fees are not refundable. If a payment is deducted but no balance is credited, contact us with your transaction ID and we will investigate and correct it. Assisted-service packages are governed by the terms agreed at the time of purchase.
legal.termsS6Body: Treat other members with respect. Do not harass, threaten, defraud or solicit money from anyone. Do not share another member's photographs, contact details or family information outside the platform. Do not use Biye Kora Lagbe for anything other than finding a marriage partner. We suspend accounts that break these rules, without refunding any remaining balance.
legal.termsS7Body: We introduce members to one another; we do not guarantee a match, a response, or a marriage. We review profiles carefully but cannot independently confirm every claim a member makes. Meet, verify and decide with the same care you would use anywhere else, and involve your family.
legal.termsS8Body: You may close your account at any time from your account settings. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, that we believe to be fraudulent, or that is required to be closed by law. Some records are kept after closure where the law requires it — see the Privacy Policy.
legal.termsS9Body: We may update these terms as the service changes. Material changes are announced on the site, and continuing to use Biye Kora Lagbe after a change means you accept the updated terms.
legal.termsS10Body: These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh. For any question about them, write to biyekoralagbe@gmail.com or use the contact page.
legal.privacyS1Body: The account details you register with (mobile number, email address, password, date of birth and gender); the profile information you enter (name, location, education, career, family, physical attributes, lifestyle and your written introduction); photographs you upload; National ID details if you choose to verify; your approximate location if you allow it; and a record of your payments, unlocks and messages.
legal.privacyS2Body: To show your profile to suitable members and theirs to you, to review profiles before they go live, to run the wallet and unlock system, to deliver messages, to detect fraud and abuse, and to answer you when you contact support.
legal.privacyS3Body: Members who have not unlocked your profile see your profile ID, your photographs blurred, and your bio-data — age, height, education, career, family, lifestyle and location. They do not see your name, mobile number, email address or full street address. Those four are revealed only to a member who pays to unlock your profile, and messaging opens at the same moment.
legal.privacyS4Body: We do not sell your personal information. We do not publish your mobile number, email address or National ID. We do not post to your social accounts. We do not share your details with advertisers.
legal.privacyS5Body: Only with the service providers who make the platform work — our hosting and image storage provider, our SMS gateway, and the bKash and Nagad payment gateways — and each receives only what it needs. We also disclose information when a court or a competent authority in Bangladesh lawfully requires it.
legal.privacyS6Body: We keep your profile while your account is open. When you close it we remove your profile from search and from other members' view; payment and verification records are retained where the law requires, and conversations are retained for the other participant's copy.
legal.privacyS7Body: You can edit or delete any profile field, replace or remove photographs, mark your income private, change your password, and close your account at any time from your account settings. To request a copy of your data or its deletion, contact us.
legal.privacyS8Body: Passwords are stored hashed, never in plain text. Access to member data is restricted to the staff who review profiles and answer support. No system is perfectly secure, so please choose a strong password and never share it.
legal.privacyS9Body: For any privacy question, or to ask us to correct or delete your information, write to biyekoralagbe@gmail.com or use the contact page.
